## Activity

During January 2026, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 76 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and supports review of the service’s operational workload. The recorded activity should be considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes to identify any issues requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 76 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.9 per cent. This result should be monitored through routine quality assurance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that equipment or operational problems can be reviewed and addressed promptly.

## Grading

Grading identified 11 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates the typical interval for cases to progress from image capture to a completed grade during January 2026. The site should continue to review turnaround and image quality as part of regular service monitoring, with particular attention to ungradable images and any recurring camera problems.
